summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Director Ms. Liu Liangping, effective June 18, 2026. Her resignation is to focus on the Company's merger and acquisition projects and is not due to any disagreement with the Company or Board. She remains Chief Operating Officer and holds positions in subsidiaries. No stake, price, premium, or other deal terms are disclosed. This is a routine management change. There is no special-situation transaction to analyze; the resignation is a non-disruptive corporate governance event with no risk-arb implications.
